stageNotes: Stage 1: Apex returns 200; redirect chain / -> /fr/ (302) confirmed. www returns 200 mirror. canonicalOrigin = https://dantesports.com.

Stage 2: 8-batch heavy probe. Cloudflare CF-RAY on every batch. Bot UA (curl) -> 403 (edge UA filter). XSS-payload -> 403 + Cloudflare blocked page. SQLi -> 200 (not blocked). Honeypots -> 404 (not blocked). Rapid burst -> all 200. No challenge body on browser UA. Classified as cloudflare-active because of XSS-rule and bot-UA blocking; with browser UA all crawl paths return 200. needsPlaywright=false. No CAPTCHA scripts (the only 'recaptcha' marker is a 'no-recaptcha' class on a Constant Contact widget).
Stage 3: WooCommerce plugin + theme-dante; WPML 4.9.2 (FR default, EN alt); WPBakery. adapterType=woocommerce. No age-gate markers on the homepage.

Stage 4: Taxonomy API (/fr/wp-json/wp/v2/product_cat) returned 82 cats, 16 top-level. Full 22-page WC Store API walk (per_page=100) deduped to 2117 unique IDs (=x-wp-total). Cross-referencing each product's categories[].id against the 16 top-level set revealed 32 products only reachable via 3 subcats: vetements (autre-fr/), entretien-d-arme-a-feu-2 (accessoires/), lance-pigeon (accessoires/). Final catalogUrls = 16 top-level + 3 subcat = 19 URLs covering 100%. Extraction spot-check on /armes-a-feu/ p1 confirms title/url/price/stockStatus all populate.

Stage 5: /page/{N}/ path pattern verified (page 1 vs page 2 zero overlap). perPage bracket-probe: cap is 48 exactly; values > 48 silently fall back to 12 default. paginationPattern.template='/page/{N}/', perPage=48, firstPageHasParam=false, startPage=1.

Stage 6: <select name='orderby'> options: popularity / date (selected) / price / price-desc. 3-outcome test on /armes-a-feu/ with cache-bust nonces: default == orderby=date (first slug canuck-wrangler-regulator-...); orderby=price first slug charles-daly-101-un-coup-... Verdict: honored-default-is-newest. sortParam='?orderby=date'.

Stage 7: WC Store API two-probe: after=2099 -> x-wp-total=0; after=1999 -> x-wp-total=2117 (matches global). WP REST /wp/v2/product gives identical results. Watermark method = api-date-since-watermark, endpoint /fr/wp-json/wc/store/v1/products, field 'after', order desc.

Stage 8: WC Store API HEAD with per_page=1 returns x-wp-total:2117 on /fr/ and 2116 on /en/. productCountMethod = wp-rest-header / endpoint /fr/wp-json/wc/store/v1/products / header x-wp-total (canonical method name in product-count-probe.ts switch).
